      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/eruan/grids.lua",
      "source": "A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.\nThis one seems to go to the west, to Charred Scar. A fiery volcano that can only spell death...",
